projectTitle: Sustainable Building Materials in Africa (2015–2025): A Rapid Systematic Review
author: Agbeniga Agboola

modules.purpose: Formal protocol documents detailing rationale, objectives, eligibility, databases, and synthesis strategy
Database query strings, hit counts, execution dates, and exported RIS bibliographic entries
Title/abstract and full-text screening records based on PRISMA 2020 criteria
Structured data extraction sheets and standardized data dictionary
Risk of bias and critical appraisal records using JBI and CASP frameworks
Thematic analysis, narrative synthesis, cross-country comparisons, and figures
Journal manuscript drafts and submission deliverables
PRISMA 2020 checklists, flow diagrams, and supplementary data tables
